ownerDecision: On October 16, 2026 the owner chose to add the renamable tab titles tile to the Features page before v1.35.0 is published, so it can go live with the next site deploy, accepting that visitors may read about it before the release reaches them.
publishGate: Once v1.35.0 is public, move these claims to a ledger tied to the v1.35.0 tag and retire this file and its test.

renameTabs.qualification: Tab names (F46): Rename Tab… in the tab context menu and /rename in the ⌘L or Ctrl+L panel set tab.customTitle (renameTab, beginRenameTab in main.js); Reset Tab Title or /rename alone clears it. The name survives navigation, quieting, moving to a new window, reopen-closed (closed-tabs.js), spaces and restart; History and Favorites keep the page title; a private tab’s name is forgotten on quit. Every desktop platform.

claims.exactWording: Give a tab a name of your own.
claims.subject: Blanc

claims.exactWording: Right-click a tab and choose Rename Tab…, or type /rename and a name in the ⌘L or Ctrl+L panel. The name stays when you browse to another site, restart Blanc or save the tab in a space.
claims.subject: Blanc

claims.exactWording: Reset Tab Title goes back to the page’s title. History and Favorites keep the page’s own title.
